messages:
Aisha: kicked off a trace-stitch sim to test new kernel-bucket selector. timeline attached. initial sims look weird — batch sizes dropped ~20% compared to baseline :frowning:
Tom: can you paste the run id/commit?
Aisha: run 2026-03-15T09:12Z commit 5f3b7a1 — kernel selector change: prefer fused-attn on seq_len<=512. config: `token_budget_target=1500, max_batch=64, queue_policy=latency_prefer`
Ravi: any perfbot output?
perfbot: Summary: throughput -6%, p99 latency +12% for short requests. KV cache hit rate unchanged.
Jordan: hmm, latency_prefer might drain batches early, reducing coalescing. did you look at queue depth histograms?
Aisha: attaching snippet:
```
queue_depth_histogram: {0-4: 42%, 5-16: 38%, 17+: 20%}
avg_batch_tokens: 920 -> baseline 1150
```
Marta: kernel change could increase per-token compute for small seqs if fused path isn't used optimally across kernels. Also check kernel scheduling jitter.
Tom: can we run A/B with only token_budget_target change (2000) and keep kernel selector? need to isolate.
Ravi: I ran an offline trace-reenact for that: token_budget=2000 restores avg_batch_tokens to 1080 and throughput to -1%. p99 drops to +3%.
Aisha: nice — suggests tuning token budget fixes most regression. any side effects on cold KV miss bursts?
Ravi: KV cold miss tail increased for a tiny cohort (0.5% of traces) — likely prefetch window smaller because batches are larger; need to confirm.
Jordan: plan: 1) run A/B on live canary with token_budget=2000, 2) add an event to perf dashboards to track KV cold-miss cohort, 3) instrument kernel selection metrics per batch.
Marta: also add a lightweight prefetched-KV size tag on traces so we can trace regression root cause.
Aisha: I'll spin the canary and add the sim configs to the experiment repo. pinging infra to reserve nodes.
perfbot: Deploy job queued: canary/trace-stitch-2026-03-16. ETA 15m :hourglass: 
Tom: thanks, team. keep updates concise in thread.
